title: int brew smoke's session-hook arm expects the gate hook to pass and has only ever measured whether /in-session left a sentinel on the machine: on a fresh machine the keg's gate refuses, which is correct, and the smoke reads it as red
body:
## What was seen

On hv's Ubuntu VM (kovacs), 2026-10-15, ORDER 6a of ST0081 WP-06 installed the Linux package built by ORDER 3 (11017d7bd) through a local dev tap with Homebrew 7.0.9 and ran `bin/int brew smoke --keg` against the keg. Every smoke group passed but one check in "the session hooks":

```
    hook require-in-session -> 0                   FAIL
intent: the installed keg fails 1 check(s):
       - hook require-in-session returned 2 -- expected 0
```

`brew test` never ran, since it follows the red. The machine had never run `/in-session`, and `/tmp/intent` was empty.

## What was expected

The smoke passes on a machine that has never run a Claude Code session, which is the machine a keg is for. It has passed on hv's Mac at every cut.

## The mechanism (read, then driven)

`bin/.devbin/cmd/brew:347-358` (ARM 6, written at 11017d7bd) drives the four session hooks with `</dev/null` and expects each to exit 0. `require-in-session.sh` is the UserPromptSubmit GATE: with an empty payload (no slash command) it exits 0 only when `/tmp/intent/in-session-<id>.sentinel` exists for `${CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID:-unknown}`, and exits 2 with `Expected sentinel:` otherwise (lines 52-80). On hv's Mac the arm passes because every `/in-session` run leaves the session's sentinel and the `unknown` sentinel in `/tmp/intent`; on a machine where nothing has run `/in-session` the gate refuses, which is the gate working. Driven on the dev pair 2026-10-15: with a session id and no sentinel, rc 2 and the `Expected sentinel:` line; with the sentinel touched, rc 0; with the id unset, rc 0 here only because `in-session-unknown.sentinel` exists; with a `/in-session` payload and no sentinel, rc 0. So unsetting the inherited session id would not have made the arm pass on kovacs, and the arm has never measured the keg's gate hook on any machine: it measured whether somebody had run `/in-session` on the box.

The Linux smoke got it right first time: `bin/.devbin/cmd/linux:191` drives the same hook with `CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID=linux-smoke` and a prompt payload and expects rc 2 with `Expected sentinel:`, since the refusal is the proof that the hook body ran from the installed tree.

## The fix, as vc would shape it

ARM 6 drives `require-in-session` the way the Linux smoke does: a non-slash prompt payload, a session id of its own, rc 2 expected with the `Expected sentinel:` line, and the other three hooks expected at 0 as now. Size S, one arm in one file. The two smokes then hold the same form for the same hook, so a shared helper is the Highlander move if the cost is nil; otherwise the comment on each names the other.

## Where it belongs

Found before 3.2.4's cut on the Linux proof that gates ST0081's AC-06.1; the instrument is cc's (WP-06). Filed by vc from kovacs-sysadm's report, which is the artefact. hv rules the release.

## Resolution

Fixed at 163c8b58c (ST0081 WP-06) on vc's judgement of the bank `refs/bank/cc/0081/wp06-0600` (blob 88015fa6959e, base 918de3014, patch-id 2f1c1e4c4a94; landed with the same patch-id). ARM 6 now drives `require-in-session` as `cmd/linux`'s `smoke_checks` does: a prompt payload under `CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID=brew-smoke-<pid>`, and the pass is rc 2 carrying the gate script's own `Expected sentinel:` line. The id carries the run's pid because `/tmp/intent` outlives a run on a Mac, so no sentinel an earlier run or session left there can answer for it. `session-context`, `session-finish` and `post-tool-advisory` stay at 0 and the unknown hook at 1. There is no shared helper: `smoke --in` hands `smoke_checks` alone to the container's bash through `declare -f` (`cmd/linux:249`), so it can call nothing outside itself, and each comment names the other.

Measured on hv's Mac against the installed 3.2.3 keg, which is pinned and unlinked (the smoke drives the keg path, never the link). At base, under a session id with no sentinel: rc 1, with exactly this issue's failure. With the fix, in the same environment and again under the session's own id with its sentinel present: rc 0, every arm answering. vc's own run of the fix with `--keg`, under a session id with no sentinel: rc 0, with `/tmp/intent`'s sentinel count unchanged. kovacs re-runs ORDER 6a's smoke and `brew test` halves from main on vc's GO.

Proven on the machine that found it: kovacs re-ran ORDER 6a from main at d25c98629 on vc's GO, with ORDER 3's package from 11017d7bd, and it was green at rc 0 (kovacs-sysadm's report of 13:2xZ, relayed by vc). The smoke's hook arm printed `hook require-in-session refuses -> 2 ok` with no FAIL line, and `brew test` ran at rc 0.
